name: Genetic sensitivity analysis (Gsens)
model_likelihood: Linear SEM for exposure, outcome and one or two observed scores, with latent genetic variables for heritability scenarios.
prior: Optional parameter-range and sign constraints reflecting prior beliefs; no probability prior specified.
inference_algorithm: Estimate observed-score attenuation, then fit a latent SEM to the correlation matrix under supplied heritability scenarios.
estimand: Residual exposure-outcome association net of genetic confounding; confounding effect and proportion of association explained.
data_input: Genotyped cohort with exposure/outcome phenotypes; observed score/exposure/outcome correlations; SNP- or twin-based heritability estimates.
tunable_settings: Heritability scenario; one or two scores (GsensX/GsensY/GsensXY); score inclusion thresholds; constrained versus unconstrained model.
